summary: At 104ff465 the v2 declarative JSON compiler accepts only the protocol, swap and credit domains. Funding is a separate strict plugin domain: it has defineFundingFamily, its own capability-slot table and a separate funding runtime, but there is no declarative-funding compiler, no funding module catalogue and no JSON-to-FundingFamilyPlugin semantic path. The only production JSON format that currently accepts production.domain='funding' is bindings-v1, which merely imports the existing TypeScript balancerFlashManifest/balancerFlashDiscovery/balancerFlashFunding/balancerFlashFamilyOwnedAction objects (optionally balancerFlashCapture); it declares no funding semantics and is not a declarative cutover. Therefore a faithful declarative Funding JSON cannot be authored under the pinned 104ff465 framework or the no-public-TS/no-tests constraint. The handwritten listener/src/searcher/venues/production-families/balancer-flash.production.ts remains authoritative.

decisiveBlocker.capability: Compile a v2 Funding-domain JSON into the funding plugin shape (manifest, optional capture, discovery, liquidity sources/current-N read program, pure offer derivation, repayment/borrow plan fragments and a family-owned action adapter) without TypeScript bindings.

existingSource.fact: The family manifest is domain 'funding' with ownedActionAdapterIds ['balancer-flash'], requiredInfraActionAdapterIds ['assert-balance','erc20-transfer'], allowedTaxonomy [{slotKind:'flash'}], supportedLineages ['balancer-flash']; the funding semantics and family-owned action are produced by createErc20BalanceFundingSemantics/createErc20BalanceFundingOwnedAction.

BALANCER_FLASH_CONFIG pins family/lineage, the Balancer V2 Vault as both target and liquidityHolder, repayment 'transfer', paramShape 'tokens-and-amounts', priorities 1/0 and the FlashLoan(address,address,uint256,uint256) discovery event (indexed token topic 2, providerFromBlock 0).

createErc20BalanceFundingSemantics builds FundingDomainSemantics from functions: liquidity.sources snapshots one source per observed asset, liquidity.program issues balanceOf(liquidityHolder) eth-calls into a RequestProgram, deriveOffers derives fee-0 offers, and repayment.buildBorrowFragment/buildRepaymentFragment emit nested plan fragments (flashLoan root, assert-balance child, erc20-transfer repayment).

The authoritative production entry imports balancerFlashCapture/Discovery/Funding/Manifest/owned action from TS modules and calls defineFundingFamily({...}); there is no JSON import and no declarative compiler call.
The strict plugin is also a hand-written defineFundingFamily object over the same TS parts; the family has no JSON definition path.

frameworkLimitation.fact: createDeclarativeFamilyRuntime rejects every version-2 document whose production.domain is not protocol, swap or credit: 'unsupported declarative Family version/domain'.

Even past the domain check the v2 schema is route-shaped: it requires manifest, discovery, identity, instance, routes, pricing, the domain block and standard, then validates instance/routes/pricing direction declarations unconditionally. Funding's applicability table marks identity, instance, routes, pricing, exact, execution and sharedBindings as 'never'.

The compiled definition always emits discovery, identity, instance, routes, pricing, exact and execution plus a protocol/swap/credit domain block and actionAdapters; no branch or output member exists for a funding domain.

renderDataFamilyEntry narrows the v2 domain to protocol/swap/credit, throws 'unsupported declarative v2 domain' otherwise, and resolves the compiler as src/searcher/venues/declarative-${domain}.ts. There is no declarative-funding.ts at 104ff465, so the funding compiler path cannot resolve.

The capability manifest generator maps only swap/credit/protocol to define${Suffix}Family + compileDeclarative${Suffix}, rejects entry.domain outside [protocol,swap,credit], and requires the compiler root src/searcher/venues/declarative-${entry.domain}.ts.

The v2 module catalogue contains only liveStateProjection, instanceEvidence, executionProjection, pricingProjection, quoteOutput, signedBlockEvidence, oracleVictim, math, executionMath, quoteFlow, pricingFlow and trialState; there is no funding liquidity/read/offer/repayment module.

FundingDomainSemantics requires synchronous functions sources/deriveOffers and function-based borrow/repayment fragments; the funding applicability table requires manifest/discovery/funding/actionAdapters and forbids the routed-family slots; defineFundingFamily is a thin strict-plugin wrapper, not a JSON compiler, and validateFundingDomain rejects data-only funding objects.
projectFundingFamily and the 'funding' switch case project an already-loaded strict FundingFamilyPlugin into FlashLoanAdapterFamily; this is a TS-plugin projection, not a declarative definition path.
Authored design statement: Funding still has its own domain interface, but the current v2 JSON compiler accepts only Protocol/Swap/Credit; Funding must not be inferred to be JSON-ified.

nonBlockingAnalysis.note: Structural observations only; no JSON was authored or validated end-to-end, and these are not acceptance claims.
expressibleIfAFundingSchemaExisted: Discovery: the FlashLoan(address,address,uint256,uint256) topic, singleton emitter 0xBA1222...F2C8, indexed token topic 2 and providerFromBlock 0 are data-shaped; the existing discovery types already model logPatterns and singleton-indexed-address.

Liquidity: one source per observed token, target/liquidityHolder both the Balancer V2 Vault, fee 0, maxBorrow from balanceOf(Vault), planningPriority 1 and liquidityPriority 0 are simple data/pure derivation.

Repayment: 'transfer' is a static erc20-transfer fragment to the Vault with the borrowed amount; the borrow fragment is a balancer-flash root with the route children, an assert-balance child for amount+minProfit and the transfer repayment child; paramShape 'tokens-and-amounts' is a static root params shape.

Registration: manifest domain funding, ownedActionAdapterIds ['balancer-flash'], requiredInfraActionAdapterIds ['assert-balance','erc20-transfer'], allowedTaxonomy [{slotKind:'flash'}], supportedLineages ['balancer-flash'], fundingPriority and the env key are all data.
nonBlockingAnalysis.missingContract: What does not exist is a funding-domain JSON contract and compiler that turns those facts into FundingDomainSemantics functions before freezing the plugin. Until that exists, any funding JSON is either rejected (v2) or a pure TypeScript binding manifest (v1).

unblockRequirement: A public framework change is required before a faithful flash-loan:balancer-v2 Funding JSON can exist: (1) admit domain='funding' in the v2 data-family runtime and production renderer without forcing route-shaped identity/instance/routes/pricing/exact/execution blocks; (2) add a declarative-funding compiler that emits the FundingFamilyPlugin shape (manifest, optional capture, discovery, funding semantics and actionAdapters) without importing TypeScript implementation; (3) add funding module catalogue blocks for dynamic per-asset sources, the current-N balanceOf(Vault) read program, pure offer derivation (fee 0), and the 'transfer'/'tokens-and-amounts' borrow/repayment plan fragments; (4) allow the family-owned balancer-flash action adapter (or declare an equivalent wrapper/callback action); (5) extend build-declarative-production.ts and build-family-capability-manifest.ts allowlists and register/load the generated entry while keeping the existing funding plugin contract tests green. This is out of scope for the JSON-only, no-public-TS/no-tests task.
nextSteps: Keep listener/src/searcher/venues/production-families/balancer-flash.production.ts and the funding TS modules unchanged.
Do not author a v1 bindings-only 'JSON cutover': it would not migrate semantics and would still need the generator plus a TypeScript entry.
Do not narrow the family to a route-shaped Protocol/Swap/Credit JSON; such a definition would fail the funding plugin contract and would not preserve funding discovery/liquidity/repayment behavior.
If the framework later gains a funding-domain JSON compiler and a funding module catalogue, re-run this assessment and then author the JSON under the normal migration validation.
